summary: Minciencias publishes a server-rendered Drupal table of all calls at /convocatorias/todas (plain HTTP, 200, no cookies, apertura date in a machine-readable content attribute). Each call has a detail page /node/<id> with a plain-text Cierre (deadline) line. A new html_listing adapter with one detail hop yields real live calls. The existing html adapter stores no rows, so it cannot be used. The row url must change to the listing, because node/9324 is a news article and Convocatoria 49 (node/9321) closed 2026-05-08.

engine_requirements: New adapter html_listing in engine (extract.ts or a new adapters/html_listing.ts). (1) Fetch GET listing_url?page=N with N=0,1,2... using the edge UA, no cookies, 10 s spacing per host (robots Crawl-delay 10, not 2 s). (2) Per row: match blocks; id and title from TITLE; apertura date from the first content="YYYY-MM-DDT..." attribute in that row. Stop paging when apertura < today - window_days, when a page has no rows, or at max_pages. (3) Detail hop per node not cached or with status open/unknown: GET /node/ (follow the 301 alias), strip scripts and tags, regex Cierre , months enero..diciembre. Deadline open if >= today, closed if before. No Cierre line: status unknown (store, never drop, never mark closed). (4) Map to opportunity: external_id minciencias-node-, title, url https://minciencias.gov.co/node/, deadline, status, description = Descripcion cell plus apertura date. (5) Budget: 4 listing + 18 detail fetches at 10 s each is about 3.7 min on first run, so persist the detail cache across runs or cap detail fetches per invocation. Steady state is about 4 listing fetches plus the few open or unknown rows. (6) Optional keyword_any filter on title+description, because the list mixes health, education and doctoral calls.
